test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly navigated to the Magento admin sales order page (http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_order/). Since the execution summary shows multiple actions but no specific parameter values, I've generated realistic test inputs based on common Magento order search scenarios. These include: a sample order ID (100000001), common status (Processing), date range covering 2024, typical order amount range, common customer name, English store view, 50 records per page, and CSV export format - all matching the tool's schema requirements for testing order filtering functionality.
